requirements.text: Every pricing and risk model is registered in the model inventory and tiered under MRM-STD-010 before use, with IMA models classified Tier 1.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: No model is used for official valuation or capital before Model Risk Committee approval after independent validation, and new products are not traded without an approved or temporarily approved model.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: IMA model changes and extensions are classified under the applicable RTS on materiality of changes, and changes requiring prior supervisory approval are not implemented before approval.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0). The RTS on materiality of changes to market risk internal models under CRR3 is not cited by number; confirm the applicable delegated regulation.

requirements.text: The trading desk structure for IMA eligibility is documented and approved, including business strategy, risk limits and the model assigned to each desk.
requirements.level_reason: Organisational requirement on the trading desk structure; evidenced in the approved trading desk policy, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.article: MR-STD-500 §5.1; CRR Part Three Title IV Chapter 1b
requirements.text: ES is calculated daily at the 97.5th percentile, one-tailed, for each IMA trading desk and for all IMA desks together.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0). EU application date of the IMA own funds requirements has been postponed; confirm current date for transitional use of VaR/SVaR models.

requirements.text: ES uses a ten-day base horizon scaled to the prescribed liquidity horizons, and the mapping of risk factors to liquidity horizon categories is documented.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: ES is calibrated to a twelve-month stress period identified from data back to at least 2007 using a reduced risk factor set explaining at least 75% of full ES, reviewed quarterly.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: Market data time series are updated at least monthly, and proxies and data filling methods are documented with their impact on ES assessed quarterly.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: Material non-linear positions are fully revalued, and any sensitivity- or grid-based approximation is justified by quantitative evidence of accuracy.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.article: MR-STD-500 §6.1; RTS on risk factor modellability
requirements.text: The risk factor eligibility test is performed at least quarterly for every risk factor based on verifiable real price observations over the preceding twelve months.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0). RFET per the RTS on the criteria for assessing modellability of risk factors (Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2060).

requirements.text: Non-modellable risk factors are capitalised through a stress scenario risk measure calibrated at least as prudently as ES under the stress period, with calibration and correlation assumptions documented.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: The use of external data vendors for real price observations is documented, including controls over completeness and verification of the data.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: The DRC model measures default and migration-to-default losses over one year at the 99.9th percentile assuming constant positions.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: DRC default correlations are estimated from equity prices or credit spreads over at least ten years including the stress period, with the factor structure documented.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: DRC PDs are consistent with IRB PDs where available, floored at 0.03%, and the source of each PD is documented.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.article: MR-STD-500 §8.1; CRR Art. 325bf; RTS on back-testing and PLA
requirements.text: Each IMA desk is back-tested daily at the 99th and 97.5th percentile VaR; a desk with more than twelve or thirty overshootings respectively in 250 business days leaves the IMA.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0). Thresholds consistent with CRR3 Art. 325bf and Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2059.

requirements.text: Firm-wide back-testing at the 99th percentile is performed daily and overshootings determining the multiplier add-on are reported to the Market Risk Committee.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.article: MR-STD-500 §8.3; CRR Art. 325bg; RTS on back-testing and PLA
requirements.text: The PLA test is performed quarterly per desk using Spearman correlation and the Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic, with red-zone desks capitalised under the standardised approach.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0). PLA metrics per Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2059.

requirements.text: HPL-RTPL differences are analysed at risk factor level, and every structural difference is recorded and addressed through a remediation plan.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to IMA own funds models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: Pricing models are calibrated to observable market instruments where available, with daily monitoring of calibration errors against thresholds and escalation of breaches.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to valuation and XVA models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: The model documentation states model limitations and resulting usage restrictions on products, parameter ranges and maturities.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to valuation and XVA models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: Valuation inputs are classified by IFRS 13 fair value hierarchy level, and day-one profit on instruments with significant unobservable inputs is deferred.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to valuation and XVA models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0). Fair value hierarchy per IFRS 13 (paraphrased; no IFRS text quoted).

requirements.text: XVA exposure simulation uses risk-neutral calibration consistent with trade pricing, reflects netting and collateral agreements, and captures material wrong-way risk.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to valuation and XVA models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: CVA uses market-implied PDs and LGDs from CDS or documented and validated proxy curves for counterparties without liquid CDS.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to valuation and XVA models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: The FVA funding curve and the treatment of the DVA-FVA overlap are documented and approved by the Valuation Committee.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to valuation and XVA models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: Model reserves for known model limitations are quantified, documented and reviewed at least quarterly.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to valuation and XVA models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: Market prices and model inputs are verified at least monthly by Product Control independently of the risk-taking units, with differences above thresholds adjusted and reported.
requirements.level_reason: Obligation of Product Control under the independent price verification process; evidenced in IPV reports, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to valuation and XVA models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: AVAs are calculated for all fair-valued positions at a 90% level of certainty under Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/101 and deducted from CET1.
requirements.level_reason: Institution-wide prudent valuation obligation; evidenced in the prudent valuation framework and own funds reporting, not in model documentation.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to valuation and XVA models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).

requirements.text: The model risk AVA is estimated from the range of valuations produced by plausible alternative models or calibrations, or by an approved and documented expert-based approach.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to valuation and XVA models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0). Model risk AVA per Art. 11 of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2016/101.

requirements.text: Model risk identified in open validation findings is reflected in the model risk AVA or a model reserve until the finding is closed.
requirements.not_applicable_reason: Applies to valuation and XVA models only.
requirements.verification_note: Internal document text authored for the library (MR-STD-500 v3.0).
